changes.description: `smithy_test.aio.check_client_case_async` takes a case's operation input as a mapping of keyword arguments and calls the operation with them. Endpoint tests must be regenerated with a code generator that writes the input this way.
`verify_models` checks that every dictionary form a model stub declares, a `TypedDict` or a union of them, is `dict` at runtime.
`verify_models` expects operation input members named `plugins` or `self` under their escaped names.
